title.narrative: Athar Saudi Volunteer Program, the diagnostic volunteer project for specialized surgeries 1

description.narrative: Identifying hospitals in the city of Port Sudan and neighboring cities in order to determine on the ground the possibility of implementing volunteer projects, and to know the need in terms of medical specialties, consumables, and medical equipment necessary to implement volunteer projects.

Sending a field medical team to evaluate several hospitals in the city of Port Sudan and its neighboring cities in order to determine in the field the possibility of implementing volunteer projects, and to know the need in terms of medical specialties, consumables and medical equipment necessary to implement volunteer projects. - Review the current situation in health facilities in the Republic of Sudan to implement projects.
